verdict.reasoning: Leave-one-study-out needs on the order of 5+ independent studies for a meaningful held-out transfer estimate. Here there are only 2 truly independent studies (Schlegel 2022 rat; Patel 2022 human) across 3 GEO series and 6 conditions, and the conditions within a study share siRNA reagents, seeds, and cell context, so they are not independent folds. Training a learned off-target predictor ON the real off-target corpus with LOSO is NOT viable: the independent-study count is low single digits.
verdict.recommendation: Use the miRNA auxiliary corpus as the TRAINING signal (McGeary 2019: 72743 real measured (seed, 3'UTR, repression) examples across 17 seeds, plus TargetScan context++ and AGO-RBNS Kd), and hold out the 2-3 real siRNA off-target studies (GSE184929 / GSE164289 / GSE196839) as a small leave-one-study-out TRANSFER-validation set, not as the training corpus.
